blocks.en: \textbf{Note:} Although we have defined operators to be maps between Banach spaces, most of the applications of operator theory that we address in this book will be to maps between separable Hilbert spaces. Thus, in many of the theorems below, we have given either statements or proofs only for the case of Hilbert spaces or separable Hilbert spaces. This practice greatly reduces the amount of machinery we need to develop, but it also limits the possible applications one can address using only material from this book. This is one of the prices you pay for learning functional analysis ``in the street.''
blocks.zh: \textbf{Note:} 虽然将算子定义为 Banach 空间之间的映射, 但本书所讨论的算子理论应用, 大多涉及可分 Hilbert 空间之间的映射. 因而在下面的许多定理中, 只对 Hilbert 空间或可分 Hilbert 空间的情形给出陈述或证明. 这种做法大大减少了需要发展的工具, 但也限制了仅用本书材料所能处理的应用范围. 这是在 ``街头'' 学习泛函分析所付出的代价之一.

blocks.en: In order to accommodate unbounded operators we begin this section with the following extended definition.

blocks.en: Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces. A linear operator from $X$ to $Y$ is a pair $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ consisting of a subspace $\mathcal{D}(A)\subset X$ (called the \textbf{domain} of the operator) and a linear transformation $A:\mathcal{D}(A)\to Y$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 和 $Y$ 为 Banach 空间. 从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的线性算子是一个对 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$, 由子空间 $\mathcal{D}(A)\subset X$ (称为算子的\textbf{定义域}) 和线性变换 $A:\mathcal{D}(A)\to Y$ 组成.
blocks.label: def:linear-operator-with-specified-domain

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Many mathematics students have had to endure a calculus teacher who insisted that there was a profound difference between the function $f(x)=x$ with domain $[0,1]$ and the same function defined on the whole real line. The students soon realize that in most cases the distinction can be ignored. In the course of this chapter, we shall see that including the domain in the definition of an operator is more than just pedantry. For unbounded operators, the specification of the domain can make a real difference. However, after having made such a big deal of the importance of the domain in the definition of an operator, we will often use sloppy language which ignores the point. That is, we will often refer to ``the operator $A$'' and leave the domain unspecified. This usage is standard and unambiguous in the study of bounded operators (whose domain, we see in Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension} below, can be extended to all of $X$), and when there is no chance of confusion, we simply stick with the shorter nomenclature even for unbounded operators.
blocks.zh: 许多数学学生都不得不忍受这样的微积分教师: 坚持认为, 定义域为 $[0,1]$ 的函数 $f(x)=x$ 与定义在整个实直线上的同一函数有根本区别. 学生很快意识到, 在大多数情况下可以忽略这种区别. 在本章中将看到, 将定义域纳入算子的定义并非仅仅吹毛求疵. 对无界算子, 指明定义域确实可能造成实质区别. 然而, 如此强调定义域在算子定义中的重要性之后, 又常会使用忽略这一点的不严谨语言. 即经常只说 ``算子 $A$'', 而不指明定义域. 这种用法在有界算子的研究中是标准且无歧义的 (将在下面的 Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension} 中看到, 其定义域可以延拓到整个 $X$), 在没有混淆可能时, 即使对无界算子也沿用这种较简短的称谓.

blocks.zh: 将同时使用记号 $Ax$ 和 $A(x)$ 表示算子对其定义域中元素的作用.

blocks.en: With the range thus defined, we can use the following notation for the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$:\[X\supset\mathcal{D}(A)\ni x\mapsto A(x)\in\mathcal{R}(A)\subset Y.\]
blocks.zh: 如此定义值域之后, 可对算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 使用以下记号:\[X\supset\mathcal{D}(A)\ni x\mapsto A(x)\in\mathcal{R}(A)\subset Y.\]

blocks.en: The sets $X$ and $Y$ are sometimes referred to as the \emph{corange} and the \emph{codomain} in order to distinguish them from their subspaces, the domain and range, respectively. Although we agree with the importance of the distinction, we shall not adopt these terms.
blocks.zh: 有时将集合 $X$ 和 $Y$ 分别称为\emph{余值域}和\emph{陪域}, 以区别于它们各自的子空间, 即定义域和值域. 虽然认同这种区分的重要性, 但不采用这些术语.
